key_highlights: ASX closed higher as easing oil prices offset Fed uncertainty; Wall Street fell on Fed chief commentary (#18, #45)
AUD crushed after Fed 'Warshach test' failure, pressuring import costs and commodity-linked equities (#28)
IMF urges Australia to cut spending ahead of a looming RBA rate hike, compounding state interest-cost pressures (#22, #19)
Gold exploration momentum: Augustus targeting 30g/t WA, Aguia record Colombian grades, Auric fast-tracking Burbanks plant (#5, #49, #51)
Barkly NT rare-earth discovery across 23km adds to critical-minerals pipeline (#53)
Middle East oil-supply tightening and east-coast fuel distribution crunch raise energy-cost risks (#12, #37, #68)
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency contagion; private-credit exposure to rich-listers flagged (#41, #38)
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling AI infrastructure build-out (#50)
Consumer stress: Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse; real wage growth crushed by exploited labour (#76, #34)
ACCC moves to break real-estate agency monopoly; tenant relief signals policy shift (#25, #8)

sectors.trend: Gold exploration activity accelerating (Augustus 30g/t target, Aguia record grades, Auric Burbanks plant). Barkly NT rare-earth discovery adds critical-minerals optionality. Coal policy uncertainty under Albo government; new mining-objection laws and landcare opposition to a billion-dollar mine create regulatory headwinds.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (NVA.AX, GWN.AX, WES.AX) benefit from exploration upside and safe-haven flows amid Fed uncertainty. Rare-earths (LRE.AX, RRL.AX) gain strategic premium. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) faces policy risk. Mining-objection reforms may delay project timelines.

sectors.trend: State governments face soaring interest costs as IMF warns of another rate hike. Bathla insolvency triggers contagion risk. Private-credit exposure to wealthy borrowers flagged. ACCC targeting real-estate agency monopoly. Australian credit growth outpacing China.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face margin pressure from rate-hike cycle but benefit from credit growth. Insolvency contagion (Bathla) and private-credit stress could hit NAB.AX, WBC.AX loan books. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by ACCC regulatory action.

sectors.trend: Crude prices soaring on tightening global supply; Middle East oil-shock risk elevated. East-coast fuel distribution crunch at ports. Green-hydrogen spending questioned; coal policy direction unclear.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX), Origin (ORG.AX) benefit from higher oil/LNG prices but face supply-logistics risk. Green-hydrogen names (SUN.AX, H2A.AX) face policy-funding uncertainty. Fuel distributors face margin squeeze.

sectors.trend: Cue and Veronika Maine face collapse after difficult period. Real wage growth crushed by exploited labour. Tenants see policy relief. Trump policy risk to Australian house prices.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, LPX.AX, IAG.AX) under pressure from wage stagnation. REITs and property (GPW.AX, CGP.AX) face Trump-driven house-price risk. Tenant relief may support rental REITs (ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) occupancies.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn datacentre deal in western QLD signals major AI infrastructure build. AI-doom narrative viral but market resilient. US tech (Nvidia, AMD, Seagate) showing strength.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data/infrastructure plays (WBC.AX, CSL.AX digital health) benefit from AI capex. QLD datacentre supports local construction (WBC.AX, GPT.AX). AI sentiment supports global tech but ASX exposure limited.

sectors.trend: Iraqi-Australian researchers advance type-1 diabetes treatment. Allied-health cap for veterans scrapped. Superannuation fitness-for-purpose questioned.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SSW.AX, XRO.AX benefit from R&D pipeline and policy support. Superannuation reform debate (SGF.AX, HUB.AX) could reshape fund flows long-term.

Gold and critical-minerals exploration as structural tailwind
State debt and IMF fiscal warning creating sovereign-credit overhang
Middle East oil-supply risk and fuel logistics as inflationary pressure
Consumer wage stagnation and retail insolvencies signalling demand softness
AI infrastructure capex (Anthropic QLD) as long-term growth catalyst
Regulatory shifts: ACCC real-estate action, mining-objection laws, tenant relief

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue ASX names; monitor RBA response to IMF pressure
Overweight energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX); monitor Brent/WTI and fuel-distributor logistics
Underweight state-linked infrastructure; favour federal-revenue banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)
Screen loan books of NAB.AX, WBC.AX; avoid high-yield credit exposure
Shift from discretionary (WOW.AX) to staples (WES.AX, CPL.AX); monitor retail sales data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Trump policy spillover on AUD house prices
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT exposure (GPW.AX, CGP.AX); monitor housing-credit data

opportunities.rationale: Record grades (Augustus, Aguia), Barkly NT rare-earths, and safe-haven flows from Fed/AUD weakness support sector re-rating

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil-supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: Crude soaring on Middle East risk; east-coast fuel crunch supports domestic energy margins

opportunities.recommendation: Position for AI infrastructure build-out in QLD
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn datacentre deal drives construction, power, and telecom demand in western QLD
Wage stagnation and consumer stress favour essential-spending names; diabetes R&D pipeline adds optionality

defensive_moves.rationale: AUD crushed on Fed failure; Trump house-price risk and ACCC real-estate action pressure property valuations
Cue/Veronika Maine insolvencies, wage stagnation, and Bathla contagion signal demand and credit deterioration

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate-hike risk via short-duration bonds or inverse ETFs
defensive_moves.rationale: IMF warns of another RBA hike; state interest costs already soaring

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to modestly higher as oil-price easing supports miners but Fed uncertainty and AUD weakness cap upside. Energy names outperform on supply tightness. Consumer and REITs lag. Watch RBA response to IMF fiscal warning.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds in gold, critical minerals, and AI infrastructure capex support selective outperformance. However, state-debt spiral, wage stagnation, and potential RBA hikes create a headwind for rate-sensitive sectors. Superannuation reform debate could reshape fund flows over 12 months.
